findings.claim: The dedicated selector uses `id` as the material identity even though the production catalog contract uses `materialId`; reopening cannot rehydrate the current choice and clicking a card submits the literal string `undefined`, after which the main dialog normalizes back to its first/default material instead of the chosen finish.

apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/library/catalog_provider.rb:213-222 forwards those material rows unchanged.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/dialog.html:1971-1974 correctly indexes catalog rows by materialId and sends that value as currentMaterialId at 2095-2101.

apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/material_selector.html:755-759,1022-1033,1051-1061,1066-1068 instead read mat.id; rendered cards therefore carry data-id=undefined and currentMaterialId never matches.

findings.claim: Choosing “Valor por defecto de la obra” is silently ignored: the scope reaches the main dialog but is never read, so the action updates only the current furniture/library draft and never persists a project default.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/material_selector.html:662-671 offers furniture versus project scope and 1110-1120 sends the selected scope.

apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/ui/option_selector_controller.rb:99-106 parses and forwards scope, and apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/ui/dialog_controller.rb:190-195 injects it into onMaterialChoiceApplied.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/dialog.html:3124-3168 never reads payload.scope and has no project-default persistence path.
docs/architecture/catalog-option-selector.md:162-175 defines project defaults as distinct state inherited by items; this behavior is absent.

findings.claim: Material application is not bound to the context that opened the floating selector; it infers the destination later from mutable selection, active library definition, and active tab, so changing SketchUp selection or main-dialog context while the selector is open can apply the finish to a different furniture item.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/dialog.html:2095-2101 opens the selector with only role, roleName, and currentMaterialId—no origin or furniture instance identity.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/ui/dialog_controller.rb:170-197 preserves no target identity in the callback.

apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/dialog.html:3129-3152 chooses the target from current selectedInstance/inspectorDef/tab state at callback time and immediately invokes update_furniture.
docs/architecture/catalog-option-selector.md:256-272 models targetFurnitureInstanceId/targetComponentInstanceId precisely to avoid this ambiguity.

findings.claim: An update carrying an instanceId can rebuild the wrong selected group: if the requested identity is not found, target lookup falls back to the first current selection, and the builder clears that group before rendering the requested furniture.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/ui/dialog_controller.rb:117-129 returns `search_entities_for_instance(instance_id) || first` even when first failed the requested identity check.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/ui/dialog_controller.rb:101-111 forwards that fallback entity to update_furniture.

apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/model/furniture_builder.rb:114-125 starts an edit operation and calls group.entities.clear! before rebuilding, so an unrelated selected group loses its contents.

findings.claim: Layout resolution fails open: authentication, license, network, 422, and other server errors all become nil, and insert/update then silently renders a generic cabinet and reports success; on update this clears the authoritative composition and replaces it with approximation geometry.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/library/catalog_provider.rb:327-342 returns nil for every non-200 layout response, and 236-247 also returns nil on transport/auth errors.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/ui/dialog_controller.rb:101-111 passes that nil layout into the builder without surfacing resolution failure.

apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/model/furniture_builder.rb:120-125 clears existing entities; 159-165 interprets nil as permission to render_generic_parametric_layout and returns a success result.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/dialog.html:3065-3074 presents the builder result as a successful in-place update.
docs/architecture/sketchup-interaction-model.md:185-190 says invalid/inactive material choices must produce explicit 422 and never a silent fallback.

findings.claim: Workshop-controlled catalog strings are interpolated into innerHTML without escaping inside a privileged HtmlDialog; a stored event-handler payload in a category/material name or manufacturer can execute JavaScript, invoke the SketchUp bridge, and read/exfiltrate the bearer media token delivered to the dialog.
proof_refs: backend-go/internal/api/furniture_catalog.go:84-110 projects database names/manufacturers/categories directly into JSON.

apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/material_selector.html:832-837,858-874,894-910,935-951,1022-1048 interpolate c.label/cat.name/mat.name/mat.manufacturer into innerHTML with no encoder.

apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/ui/dialog_controller.rb:357-367 supplies the session bearer token as media.token, and the selector document has no Content-Security-Policy.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/ui/option_selector_controller.rb:82-85 exposes selector_ready, apply_selection, and close_selector callbacks to that same document.

findings.claim: The login surface accepts a non-loopback plain-HTTP server URL and posts the user's email and password over it, allowing credential disclosure in transit.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/transport/http_adapter.rb:62-71 accepts both http:// and https:// without restricting HTTP to localhost.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/auth/session_provider.rb:40-46 sends the raw email and password to /auth/login.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/transport/http_adapter.rb:81-86 enables TLS only for URI::HTTPS, so accepted HTTP hosts use cleartext.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/dialog.html:1604-1610 provides no transport-security validation or warning before login.

findings.claim: The new material selector cannot be operated end-to-end by keyboard: category rows, breadcrumbs, and material cards are non-focusable div/span elements with click-only handlers, and the documented arrow navigation is absent, blocking keyboard-only users from changing a finish.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/material_selector.html:832-848,858-885,894-920,935-960,1031-1063 renders interactive spans/divs without role, tabindex, or keyboard handlers.

apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/material_selector.html:1155-1165 handles only Escape, Enter, and Ctrl/Cmd+F; it implements no arrow navigation and Enter cannot choose an unfocusable card.
docs/architecture/catalog-option-selector.md:318-325 explicitly requires Left/Right and Up/Down navigation across columns and items.

findings.claim: Material application mutates the main UI and announces success before Ruby confirms the update; on failure the prior choice is not restored or rehydrated, leaving displayed configuration and model metadata out of sync.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/dialog.html:3132-3155 updates inspectorMaterialChoices, rerenders, invokes update_furniture, then immediately shows “Acabado actualizado”.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/dialog.html:3065-3075 reports a later update error but performs no rollback or selection re-read.
apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/ui/option_selector_controller.rb:99-109 closes on apply and only logs exceptions, giving the selector no recoverable error state.

findings.claim: The dedicated selector discards the role's curated eligibility set and sends every active workshop material, so after the identity bug is fixed it will expose choices that the furniture definition did not offer for that role.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/dialog.html:1978-1984 filters each role through roleEntry.optionIds for the inline/main representation but sends no optionIds at 2095-2101.

findings.claim: The selector reads `grainDefault` while the SketchUp catalog DTO emits `grain`, so every grain-bearing board is presented as smooth/non-grained and its technical detail is wrong.
proof_refs: backend-go/internal/api/furniture_catalog.go:100-101 serializes the field as grain and 253-275 maps GrainDefault into that field.

findings.claim: Delete does not verify Granete furniture metadata and has no confirmation; the callback erases whatever entity is first in the live SketchUp selection, so stale UI state can delete an unrelated object.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/ui/dialog_controller.rb:373-381 obtains selection.first and erases it without checking kind/identity.

The operation is undoable, limiting permanent loss, but it still violates the displayed “Eliminar Mueble” target promise.

findings.claim: The allowed selector window sizes do not support its five-zone layout: at three category levels the Miller pane can consume about 480 px and the inspector fixes 300 px, leaving the 170 px-minimum swatch grid clipped at the 960 px default and effectively absent near the allowed 760 px minimum; no compact breakpoint exists.

apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/material_selector.html contains no responsive @media rule, while docs/architecture/catalog-option-selector.md:343-366 requires a distinct compact SketchUp layout.

findings.claim: Every filter/navigation change rebuilds the full material grid and eagerly creates full background-image requests for all matches, contrary to the catalog performance contract; dense catalogs can repeatedly block CEF and load every texture.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/resources/material_selector.html:992-1049 maps all filtered materials into innerHTML with CSS background images and no lazy-loading or virtualization.

docs/architecture/catalog-option-selector.md:370-378 requires lazy thumbnails and profiling-based virtualization for dense catalogs.

findings.claim: The remote catalog is cached for the lifetime of the session and no ordinary refresh invalidates it, so materials, categories, option sets, and definitions changed in Granete remain stale in the plugin until login/logout or process restart.
proof_refs: apps/sketchup-extension/src/granete_for_sketchup/library/catalog_provider.rb:260-270 returns @cached_contract indefinitely once populated.
